description: This file defines various classes related to serializing and deserializing web request and response bodies, including text, file, JSON, and signed variants, within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: TextBody
classes.description: A class representing a text-based request or response body, supporting serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: SignedTextBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending TextBody to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

classes.name: FileBody
classes.description: A class representing a file-based body, supporting serialization and deserialization, with file handling features.

classes.name: SignedFileBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending FileBody to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

classes.name: JSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class for JSON object bodies, supporting serialization to JSON string and deserialization.

classes.name: SignedJSONBodyType
classes.description: A template class extending JSONBodyType to include hashing/signing capabilities using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the body content into a stream or buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream or buffer into the body content.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Provides access to the hash object used for signing.

methods.name: LoadHash
methods.description: Loads and computes the hash of the file content.
